views.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image1 (IMG_8640) is EDIT TARGET: view from steel reception doors towards kitchen, sofa on left, TV/shelf on right. Preserve its camera and room geometry. Input image2 (IMG_8641) is supporting reference for opposite view, TV wall, existing ladder shelf and exact red Vietnamese hat. One landscape photorealistic image, no collage.
Remove temporary people visible in kitchen and all loose work/clothing clutter from sofa/room; retain kitchen units, island, dining table/chairs and garden doors beyond untouched. Do not remodel those distant spaces.
DESIGN: Living Room 01 - Warm & Personal. Existing middle TV area between black steel reception screen and open kitchen.
LOCK HOUSE: actual unchanged pale grey/off-white wall/ceiling colours, original white panel mouldings/cornice, continuous light oak plank floor, black steel full-width glazed screen/doors to reception, exact existing kitchen/dining/garden architecture. No painting, new wall cladding, slat walls, fireplace, ceiling fixtures, new windows or architectural changes. Retain actual existing TV screen SIZE, do not invent giant screen.
LAYOUT / SAME PHYSICAL DESIGN FOR BOTH VIEWS:
1. TV mounted flat on original TV wall opposite sofa, at a comfortable low seated-viewing position close to original screen centre, not high near ceiling. The old bulky floor-standing black TV unit is removed. Below TV a very SHALLOW floating dark walnut low cabinet with plain restrained fronts, approx140-150cm wide, 25-30cm deep, 22-25cm high, floor visible beneath; this is a light small storage element, NOT another tall bulky TV stand, a full wall media unit or wood slat feature. One closed unit holds devices, top almost empty, clean cable route to existing power. No massive soundbar, fireplace beneath TV or white walls repaint.
2. Replace cream leather chaise with a smart STRAIGHT THREE-SEAT SOFA, approx220-225cm long, 90-95cm deep, slim straight/softly rounded arms and raised short dark timber legs. Medium warm mushroom/putty TAUPE woven upholstery, noticeably deeper than original cream, not bright white, no bulky leather, no chaise or L-shape, no extra armchair. Sofa stays against ORIGINAL PANELLED wall facing TV; do not swap room sides. Fit its length within same wall zone, preserve routes to kitchen and reception.
3. Exactly THREE cushions total on sofa: one small muted cinnamon/rust square, one soft moss/olive square, one flax lumbar with a very subtle thin tobacco stripe. One neatly folded light oatmeal throw at one sofa end only, no piles.
4. A matte low-pile wool rectangular rug anchors seating, approx200x240-250cm as a proportional idea. Light warm mushroom/stone-brown, faint worn Persian/floral pattern close in tone, subtle dusty olive/brown detail, soft border. Not a bold black or red rug, not bright ivory, not plain sisal. Sofa front feet on rug, rug stopped short of steel glazed doorway and kitchen zone with visible oak border. Keep open right/TV-side walking route; rug does not cover entire floor.
5. One SMALL LOW OVAL dark walnut coffee table around75x45cm, round-ended and visually light. Place within sofa zone, shifted toward sofa to leave main route to kitchen clear on TV side. Table holds only ONE small shallow ceramic dish or a single remote, not decor stacks. No big ottoman in middle.
6. Existing small round marble/dark-metal side table can remain at steel-door end of sofa. Add ONE modest aged-brass lamp with warm flax linen shade, around35cm high, shade20cm. Keep clear of door leaf, no floor lamp crammed next to dog bed.
ART / CLOCK: take down large clock above sofa (store/consider elsewhere, don't discard); replace with ONE traditional softly painted horizontal landscape, muted olive/umber/soft sky, thin dark wood frame with fine aged-gold slip, approx100-110x55-65cm proportionally, fits INSIDE original large sofa-wall moulding without covering any trim. No modern abstract, no gallery of tiny pictures, no more ornaments around art.
LADDER SHELF: RETAIN original black leaning ladder shelf with natural timber shelves, exact width/height/number, on original TV wall towards KITCHEN side of TV. Style selectively with user's existing personal objects: small book group on lowest shelf; shallow earthenware bowl and ONE small meaningful framed photo on middle shelves; one small low olive ceramic vase plus selected existing ornament, small book stack if space; top sparse. A few groups, empty gaps, not a mass of matching objects. No new built-in shelves, no blue book-set wall.
RED VIETNAMESE HAT: retain the SAME deep red conical/curved hat from original photo. Move it to plain wall DIRECTLY ABOVE ladder shelf as the intentional personal focal accent for that shelf, around10-15cm above shelf frame with space below cornice. Show it once only, preserve its real hat silhouette and colour. NOT beside TV near steel screen, not a lantern, painting, huge flat red disc or generic new hat. No additional red souvenirs.
PLANTS: retain actual monstera as ONE substantial floor plant close to kitchen-side of ladder shelf/TV wall in a simple warm charcoal/earth pot, keep leaves out of TV screen and corridor. One tiny shelf plant optional only if genuinely space, not jungle. Don't duplicate three giant palms.
DOG: retain actual grey raised fabric dog bed, remove it from middle walkway and trial it snug at KITCHEN END OF SOFA against sofa wall, so its footprint stays in same strip as sofa rather than TV-side route. Keep bed actual generous size (roughly90x60cm), orient short side along wall if needed; no shrinking it, no replacing it with tiny decorative basket. It can be partly occluded or beyond crop. Do not remove dog bed from scheme just to stage photo.
Light: natural garden daylight and small warm table lamp; real timber/wool/woven fabric, softly lived-in elegant room. No people, filming equipment, text, labels, watermark or collage. Not glossy CGI.
